requirements.text: The total mass of the upper legform impactor including those propulsion and guidance components which are effectively part of the impactor during the impact shall be 9.5 kg ± 0.1 kg.

requirements.quote: The upper legform impactor for the bumper test shall be mounted to the propulsion system by a torque limiting joint and be insensitive to off-axis loading.

requirements.text: The impactor shall move only in the specified direction of impact when in contact with the vehicle and shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis.
requirements.quote: The impactor shall move only in the specified direction of impact when in contact with the vehicle and shall be prevented from motion in other directions including rotation about any axis.

requirements.text: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three lower legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.
requirements.quote: Tests shall be to different types of structure, where they vary throughout the area to be assessed.

requirements.text: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected test points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The positions tested by the laboratories shall be indicated in the test report.

requirements.text: Where necessary the straight edge shall be shortened to avoid any contact with structures above the bumper.
requirements.quote: Where necessary the straight edge shall be shortened to avoid any contact with structures above the bumper.

requirements.text: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.
requirements.quote: The tibia bending moments shall not exceed +/- 15 Nm within an evaluation interval of 30 ms immediately prior to impact.

requirements.text: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.
requirements.quote: The offset compensation shall be done with the flexible lower legform impactor in resting position prior to the test/acceleration phase.

requirements.text: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.
requirements.quote: A minimum of three upper legform to bumper tests shall be carried out, one each to the middle and the outer thirds of the bumper test area at positions judged to be the most likely to cause injury.

requirements.text: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: The selected measuring points shall be a minimum of 84 mm apart as measured horizontally and perpendicular to the longitudinal median plane of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The direction of impact shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the vehicle, with the axis of the upper legform vertical at the time of first contact.

requirements.text: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance.
requirements.quote: At the time of first contact the impactor centre line shall be vertically midway between the upper bumper reference line and the lower bumper reference line with a ±10 mm tolerance

requirements.quote: the impactor vertical centre line shall be positioned laterally with the selected impact location with a tolerance of ±10 mm.

requirements.quote: (a) Tibia-1 shall be 235 Nm ≤ 272 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-2 shall be 187 Nm ≤ 219 Nm.
requirements.quote: (b) Tibia-2 shall be 187 Nm ≤ 219 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm.
requirements.quote: (c) Tibia-3 shall be 139 Nm ≤ 166 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for a test according to paragraph 1.3.3. below, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.
requirements.quote: (d) Tibia-4 shall be 90 Nm ≤ 111 Nm.

requirements.text: The absolute value of the maximum elongation of MCL shall be 20.5 ≤ 24.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (a) MCL shall be 20.5 ≤ 24.0 mm;

requirements.text: The absolute value of the maximum elongation of ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.5 mm.
requirements.quote: (b) ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.5 mm;

requirements.text: The absolute value of the maximum elongation of PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (c) PCL shall be 3.5 mm ≤ 5.0 mm.

requirements.text: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 200 ms after the impact timing.
requirements.quote: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 200 ms after the impact timing.

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for the test according to paragraph 1.4.3. of this annex, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-1 shall be 230 Nm ≤ 272 Nm.
requirements.quote: (a) Tibia-1 shall be 230 Nm ≤ 272 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for the test according to paragraph 1.4.3. of this annex, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-2 shall be 210 Nm ≤ 252 Nm.
requirements.quote: (b) Tibia-2 shall be 210 Nm ≤ 252 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for the test according to paragraph 1.4.3. of this annex, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-3 shall be 166 Nm ≤ 192 Nm.
requirements.quote: (c) Tibia-3 shall be 166 Nm ≤ 192 Nm;

requirements.text: When the flexible lower legform impactor is used for the test according to paragraph 1.4.3. of this annex, the absolute value of the maximum bending moment of the tibia at Tibia-4 shall be 93 Nm ≤ 108 Nm.
requirements.quote: (d) Tibia-4 shall be 93 Nm ≤ 108 Nm.

requirements.text: The absolute value of the maximum elongation of MCL shall be 17.0 ≤ 21.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (a) MCL shall be 17.0 ≤ 21.0 mm;

requirements.text: The absolute value of the maximum elongation of ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (b) ACL shall be 8.0 mm ≤ 10.0 mm;

requirements.text: The absolute value of the maximum elongation of PCL shall be 4.0 mm ≤ 6.0 mm.
requirements.quote: (c) PCL shall be 4.0 mm ≤ 6.0 mm.

requirements.quote: For all these values for the maximum bending moment and the maximum elongation, the readings used shall be from the initial impact timing to 50 ms after the impact timing.

requirements.text: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The lighting and light-signalling devices shall be so fitted that under normal conditions of use as defined in paragraphs 2.3.10., 2.3.10.1. and 2.3.10.2. and notwithstanding any vibrations to which they may be subjected, they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation and enable the vehicle to comply with the requirements of this Regulation.

requirements.text: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.
requirements.quote: In particular, it shall not be possible for the lamps to be inadvertently maladjusted.

requirements.text: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.
requirements.quote: The illuminating lamps described in paragraphs 2.5.1., 2.5.2. and 2.5.10. shall be so installed that correct adjustment of their orientation can easily be carried out.

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road.
requirements.quote: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be parallel to the bearing plane of the vehicle on the road;

requirements.text: For all light-signalling devices, including those mounted on the side panels, the reference axis of the lamp when fitted to the vehicle shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.
requirements.quote: in addition it shall be perpendicular to the median longitudinal plane of the vehicle in the case of side retro-reflectors and of side-marker lamps and parallel to that plane in the case of all other signalling devices.

requirements.text: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.
requirements.quote: In each direction a tolerance of ±3° shall be allowed.

requirements.text: Any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.
requirements.quote: In addition, any specific instructions as regards fitting laid down by the manufacturer shall be complied with.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions lamps constituting a pair shall be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.).
requirements.quote: Be fitted to the vehicle symmetrically in relation to the median longitudinal plane (this estimate to be based on the exterior geometrical form of the lamp and not on the edge of its illuminating surface referred to in paragraph 2.10.3.);

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, lamps constituting a pair shall have substantially identical photometric characteristics, except that this shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.
requirements.quote: Have substantially identical photometric characteristics. This shall not apply to a matched pair of a function and/or an AFS.

requirements.text: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.
requirements.quote: Lamps may be grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated with one another provided that all requirements regarding colour, position, orientation, geometric visibility, electrical connections and other requirements, if any, are fulfilled.

requirements.text: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF, except that when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.
requirements.quote: The photometric and colorimetric requirements of a lamp shall be fulfilled when all other functions with which this lamp is grouped, combined or reciprocally incorporated are switched OFF. However, when a front or rear position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with one or more other function(s) which can be switched ON together with them, the requirements regarding colour of each of these other functions shall be fulfilled when the reciprocally incorporated function(s) and the front or rear position lamps are switched ON.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: Single lamps as defined in paragraph 2.14.11.1., subparagraph (a), the apparent surface of which is composed of two or more distinct parts, shall be installed in such a way that the minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis, except that these requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.
requirements.quote: (a) Either the total area of the projection of the distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis on a plane tangent to the exterior surface of the outer lens and perpendicular to the reference axis shall occupy not less than 60 per cent of the smallest quadrilateral circumscribing the projection of the said apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis; or (b) The minimum distance between the facing edges of two adjacent/tangential distinct parts of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall not exceed 75 mm when measured perpendicularly to the reference axis. These requirements shall not apply to a single retro-reflector.

requirements.text: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.
requirements.quote: The maximum height above the ground shall be measured from the highest point and the minimum height from the lowest point of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis.

requirements.text: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.
requirements.quote: In the absence of specific instructions, the photometric characteristics (e.g. intensity, colour, apparent surface, etc.) of a lamp shall not be intentionally varied during the period when the lamp is switched ON.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary in relation to the ambient light, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary as a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary when the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function, provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.
requirements.quote: The photometric characteristics of any lamp may vary: (a) In relation to the ambient light; (b) As a consequence of other lamps being switched ON or OFF; or (c) When the lamp is being used to provide another lighting function; provided that any variation in the photometric characteristics is in compliance with the technical provisions for the lamp concerned.

requirements.text: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Red light emitted by a lamp fitted on the rear of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: White light emitted by a lamp fitted on the front of the vehicle (as defined in paragraph 2.1.5.) shall not be visible from the rear of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the front and rear position lamps, the end-outline marker lamps, if they exist, the side-marker lamps, if they exist, and the rear registration plate lamp can only be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.
requirements.quote: In the case of an interdependent lamp system, all light sources shall be switched ON and OFF simultaneously.

requirements.text: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON, except that this requirement shall not apply to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.
requirements.quote: The electrical connections shall be such that the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps and the front fog lamps cannot be switched ON unless the lamps referred to in paragraph 5.11. are also switched ON. This requirement shall not apply, however, to main-beam or dipped-beam headlamps when their luminous warnings consist of the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam headlamp or the intermittent lighting up at short intervals of the dipped-beam headlamp or the alternate lighting up at short intervals of the main-beam and dipped-beam headlamps.

requirements.text: Where the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, their electrical connections are such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again.
requirements.quote: Their electrical connections are such that in case of failure of any of these lighting devices the front position lamps are automatically switched ON again;

requirements.text: Where the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5.
requirements.quote: The substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (a) The geometric visibility prescribed for the front position lamps in 6.9.5;

requirements.text: Where the dipped-beam headlamps and/or the main-beam headlamps and/or the front fog lamps substitute the function of the front position lamps, the substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution.
requirements.quote: The substituting lamp/function meets, for the respective position lamp, the requirements concerning: (b) The minimum photometric values according to the angles of light distribution;

requirements.text: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above is provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.
requirements.quote: Appropriate evidence demonstrating compliance with the requirements indicated in paragraph 5.12.1.2. above is provided in the test reports of the substituting lamp.

requirements.text: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.
requirements.quote: The number of lamps mounted on the vehicle shall be equal to the number indicated in the individual specifications of this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.
requirements.quote: When the movable components are in a position other than a "normal position of use", the devices installed on them shall not cause undue discomfort to road users.

requirements.text: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.
requirements.quote: When a lamp is installed on a movable component and the movable component is in the "normal position(s) of use", the lamp shall always return to the position(s) specified by the manufacturer in accordance with this Regulation.

requirements.text: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.
requirements.quote: In the case of dipped-beam headlamps and front fog lamps, this requirement shall be considered satisfied if, when the movable components are moved and returned to the normal position 10 times, no value of the angular inclination of these lamps, relative to its support, measured after each operation of the movable component, differs by more than 0.15 per cent from the average of the 10 measured values.

requirements.text: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.
requirements.quote: If this value is exceeded each limit specified in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. shall then be modified by this excess to decrease the allowed range of inclinations when checking the vehicle according to Annex 6.

requirements.text: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".
requirements.quote: The apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of front and rear position lamps, front and rear direction-indicator lamps and retro-reflectors shall not be hidden more than 50 per cent by any movable component, with or without a light-signalling device installed on it, in any fixed position different from the "normal position of use".

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component.
requirements.quote: Additional lamps satisfying all the position, geometric visibility, colorimetric and photometric requirements for the above indicated lamps shall be switched ON when the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of these lamps is more than 50 per cent hidden by the movable component; or

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, a remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components.
requirements.quote: A remark in the communication form (item 10.1. of Annex 1) shall inform other Administrations that more than 50 per cent of the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis can be hidden by the movable components; and

requirements.text: If the above requirement is not practicable, a notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.
requirements.quote: A notice in the vehicle shall inform the user that in certain position(s) of the movable components other road users shall be warned of the presence of the vehicle on the road; for example by means of a warning triangle or other devices according to national requirements for use on the road.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, the voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.
requirements.quote: The voltage supplied at the terminals of devices which, according to their type approval documentation, have been tested by the application of a special power supply/electronic light source control gear, or in a secondary operating mode or at a voltage requested by the applicant, shall not exceed the voltage specified for the relevant devices or functions as they have been approved.

requirements.text: For vehicles of M and N categories, in all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.
requirements.quote: In all cases of electric power supply conditions not covered by paragraph 5.27.1., the voltage at the terminals of the device(s) or function(s) shall not exceed 6.75 V (6 Volt-Systems), 13.5 V (12 Volt-Systems) or 28 V (24 Volt-Systems) by more than 3 per cent.

requirements.text: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity, except that no account is taken of obstacles if they were already presented when the lamp was type-approved.
requirements.quote: There shall be no obstacle on the inside of the angles of geometric visibility to the propagation of light from any part of the apparent surface of the lamp observed from infinity. requirements.text: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.
requirements.quote: If, when the lamp is installed, any part of the apparent surface of the lamp is hidden by any further parts of the vehicle, proof shall be furnished that the part of the lamp not hidden by obstacles still conforms to the photometric values prescribed for the approval of the device.

requirements.quote: Lamps installed on a vehicle which is approved according to this Regulation and approved for one or more replaceable light source categories according to Regulations Nos. 37, 99 or 128, shall be fitted with light sources approved according to these light source categories only.

requirements.text: The dipped-beam headlamps shall be not less than 500 mm and not more than 1,200 mm above the ground, except that for category N2G, N3G, M2G, M3G (off-road) vehicles the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp shall be Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.
requirements.quote: Number Two Class “F3” and type-approved according to the 03 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 19, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 149.

requirements.text: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In width: that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the vehicle's median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 400 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.text: In height, the front fog lamp shall be not less than 250 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: Minimum: Not less than 250 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 800 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For all other categories except N3G (off-road) vehicles, the front fog lamp shall be not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.
requirements.quote: For all other categories except N3G (off-road) vehicles: not more than 1,200 mm above the ground.

requirements.text: For category N3G vehicles, the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.
requirements.quote: For category N3G vehicles: the maximum height may be increased to 1,500 mm.

requirements.text: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.
requirements.quote: No point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis shall be higher than the highest point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the dipped-beam headlamp.

requirements.text: In length: the front fog lamp shall be at the front of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In length: at the front of the vehicle.

requirements.text: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: This requirement shall be deemed to be satisfied if the light emitted does not cause discomfort to the driver either directly, or indirectly through the devices for indirect vision and/or other reflecting surfaces of the vehicle.

requirements.text: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.
requirements.quote: The presence of partitions or other items of equipment near the front fog lamp shall not give rise to secondary effects causing discomfort to other road users.

requirements.quote: The vertical inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver´s seat shall be – 1.0 per cent or lower.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the vertical inclination of the cut-off shall under all the static conditions of Annex 5 automatically remain between the following values: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.
requirements.quote: h > 0.8 Limits: between -1.5 per cent and -3.5 per cent Initial aiming: between -2.0 per cent and -2.5 per cent.

requirements.quote: The initial downward inclination of the cut-off to be set in the unladen vehicle state with one person in the driver's seat shall be specified within an accuracy of one decimal place by the manufacturer and indicated in a clearly legible and indelible manner on each vehicle close to either the front fog lamp or the manufacturer's plate or in combination with the indication referred to in paragraph 6.2.6.1.1. by the symbol shown in Annex 7 to this Regulation.

requirements.text: When the total objective luminous flux of the light source for each front fog lamp exceeds 2,000 lumens, the value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: The value of this indicated downward inclination shall be defined in accordance with paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, the front fog lamp levelling device shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.
requirements.quote: Where a levelling device is fitted for a front fog lamp, independent or grouped with other front lighting and light signalling functions, it shall be such that the vertical inclination, under all the static loading conditions of Annex 5 of this Regulation, shall remain between the limits prescribed in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1.

requirements.text: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.
requirements.quote: In the case where the front fog lamp is part of the dipped-beam headlamp or is part of an AFS system, the requirements of paragraph 6.2.6. shall be applied during the use of the front fog beam as part of the dipped beam.

requirements.text: The levelling device may also be used to automatically adapt the inclination of the front fog beam in relation to the prevailing ambient conditions, provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded.
requirements.quote: The levelling device may also be used to automatically adapt the inclination of the front fog beam in relation to the prevailing ambient conditions, provided that the limits for the downward inclination specified in paragraph 6.3.6.1.2.1. are not exceeded.

requirements.text: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.
requirements.quote: In the case of a failure of the levelling device, the front fog beam shall not assume a position in which the cut off is less inclined than it was at the time when the failure of the device occurred.

requirements.text: The front fog lamp electrical connections shall be such that it shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless: (a) The front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS; however, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part, or (b) The front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol ("/") according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19. or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].
requirements.quote: It shall be possible to switch the front fog lamps ON and OFF independently of the main-beam headlamps, the dipped-beam headlamps or any combination of main- and dipped-beam headlamps, unless: (a) The front fog lamps are used as part of another lighting function in an AFS; however, the switching ON of the front fog lamps function shall have the priority over the function for which the front fog lamps are used as a part, or (b) The front fog lamps cannot be simultaneously lit with any other lamps with which they are reciprocally incorporated as indicated by the relevant symbol ("/") according to paragraph 10.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. 19. or item 9.5.1. of Annex 1 of UN Regulation No. [RID].

requirements.text: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.
requirements.quote: Any variations of the luminous intensities or alignment shall be performed automatically and in such a way that no discomfort, neither for the driver nor to other road users, is caused.

requirements.quote: Arrangement "B" shall apply to trailers only.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on all motor vehicles.

requirements.quote: Mandatory on trailers over 1,600 mm wide.

requirements.text: The front position lamps shall be two in number, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.
requirements.quote: Number Two, type-approved according to the 02 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 7, or to the 00 or subsequent series of amendments to UN Regulation No. 148.

requirements.text: In the case of a trailer, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: In the case of a trailer, that point on the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis which is farthest from the median longitudinal plane shall not be more than 150 mm from the extreme outer edge of the vehicle.

requirements.quote: The distance between the inner edges of the two apparent surfaces in the direction of the reference axes shall: For M1 and N1 category vehicles: No special requirement; For all other categories of vehicles: Not less than 600 mm. requirements.text: In height: the front position lamp shall be above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.quote: In height: above the ground, not less than 250 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm for O1 and O2 categories of vehicles, or if for any other categories of vehicles the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).
requirements.quote: Where the front position lamp and another lamp are reciprocally incorporated, the apparent surface in the direction of the reference axis of the other lamp shall be used to verify compliance with the positioning requirements (paragraphs 6.9.4.1. to 6.9.4.3.).

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall meet a horizontal angle of 45° inwards and 80° outwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane, and in the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° inwards and 80° outwards. In the case of trailers, the angle inwards may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: The front position lamp shall meet a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall meet a horizontal angle of 45° outwards to 45° inwards, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards to 45° inwards. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the front position lamp shall meet a vertical angle of 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, to be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2.
requirements.quote: To be considered visible, the lamp shall provide an unobstructed view of the apparent surface of at least 12.5 cm2.

requirements.text: For M1 and N1 category vehicles, as an alternative to paragraph 6.9.5.1. above, at the discretion of the manufacturer or his duly accredited representative, and only if a front side-marker lamp is installed on the vehicle, the illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.
requirements.quote: The illuminating surface area of any retro-reflector that does not transmit light shall be excluded.

requirements.text: The front position lamp orientation shall be Forwards.
requirements.quote: Orientation Forwards.

requirements.text: The electrical connections of the front position lamp shall be in accordance with paragraph 5.11., except that if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.
requirements.quote: Electrical connections In accordance with paragraph 5.11. However, if a front position lamp is reciprocally incorporated with a direction-indicator the electrical connection of the front position lamp on the relevant side of the vehicle or the reciprocally incorporated part of it may be such that it is switched OFF during the entire time (both ON and OFF cycle) of operation of the direction-indicator lamp.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the front position lamp, except that this requirement does not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON, and a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.
requirements.quote: Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. This tell-tale shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply while the daytime running lamps are switched ON. However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component regulation.

requirements.text: The closed-circuit tell-tale shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: This tell-tale shall be non-flashing and shall not be required if the instrument panel lighting can only switch ON simultaneously with the front position lamps.

requirements.text: If one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.
requirements.quote: If one or more infrared radiation generator(s) is (are) installed inside the front position lamp, it (they) is (are) allowed to be switched ON only when the headlamp on the same side of the vehicle is switched ON and the vehicle is in forward motion.

requirements.text: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.
requirements.quote: In the event that the front position lamp or the headlamp on the same side fails, the infrared radiation generator(s) shall be automatically switched OFF.

requirements.text: A closed-circuit tell-tale shall be mandatory for the rear position lamp, except that this requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON, and a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.
requirements.quote: Tell-tale. Closed-circuit tell-tale mandatory. It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps. This requirement does not apply when daytime running lamps are switched ON. However, a tell-tale indicating failure is mandatory if required by the component Regulation.

requirements.text: The rear position lamp tell-tale shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.
requirements.quote: It shall be combined with that of the front position lamps.

requirements.text: Furthermore, if there are two parking lamps, they shall be on the sides of the vehicle.
requirements.quote: Furthermore, if there are two lamps, they shall be on the sides of the vehicle.

requirements.text: For all other categories of vehicles, the parking lamp shall be above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).
requirements.quote: For all other categories of vehicles: above the ground, not less than 350 mm nor more than 1,500 mm (2,100 mm if the shape of the bodywork makes it impossible to keep within 1,500 mm).

requirements.text: The parking lamp horizontal angle shall be 45° outwards, forwards and rearwards, except that where a front or rear parking lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.
requirements.quote: Horizontal angle: 45° outwards, forwards and rearwards. However, where a front or rear parking lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the inward angle of 45° may be reduced to 20° under the H plane.

requirements.text: The parking lamp vertical angle shall be 15° above and below the horizontal, except that where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.
requirements.quote: Vertical angle: 15° above and below the horizontal. However, where a lamp is mounted below 750 mm (measured according to the provisions of paragraph 5.8.1. above), the downward angle of 15° may be reduced to 5°.

requirements.quote: The angles of geometric visibility shall be checked in accordance with paragraph 2.10.7. of this Regulation.

requirements.quote: The values measured for the angles shall be such that the individual specifications applicable to each lamp are fulfilled except that the limits of the angles may have an allowance corresponding to the ±3º variation permitted in paragraph 5.3. for the mounting of the light-signalling devices.

requirements.quote: The lamps must be so designed and constructed that under normal conditions of use and notwithstanding the vibrations to which they may be subjected in such use, their satisfactory operation remains assured and they retain the characteristics prescribed by this Regulation.
